&api-questions;
The NetBeansFX Layout API provides stable identities and immutable values for product-owned logical areas (ViewArea), physical dock groups (DockGroupSpec) and content-free layout trees (LayoutSpec/LayoutNode) built with LayoutBuilder or read from secure standard XML with LayoutXml, including caller-resolved includes, presentations, capacities, capabilities, policy references, styling and lifecycle.
Ids are immutable, namespaced and persistable. Built-in roles/kinds are neutral; products define their own namespaced values. XML parsing disables DTDs, external entities and external resources. The module contains no JavaFX or runtime behavior.
Author a product-owned layout programmatically or as standard XML.
Validate areas, groups, references and split geometry before rendering.
Round-trip layout identity, policy references, styling and metadata without JavaFX or content instances.
Unit tests cover id parsing, immutable model validation, builder behavior, XML equality, deterministic output, inherited defaults, caller-resolved includes, exact path diagnostics and unsafe XML rejection.
A JDK is required only to compile.
Only org.netbeans.api.nbfx.layout is public.

Reads the caller-provided XML stream and streams returned by an explicit include resolver; performs no module resource lookup or implicit filesystem/network access.

Readers and writers are stateless. Builders are local mutable operations and are not thread-safe. None of these APIs has thread affinity.
